runnerRequirements: D-102 class ubuntu-24.04: the release profile is measured on that image, including the kernel flavor and series it actually boots (SEC3-M6); a fixed series is never assumed
stock Ubuntu 24.04 kernel package of the measured flavor/series installed through apt-secure from the Ubuntu archive (linux-azure on hosted images is a Canonical-signed archive kernel)

bootAttestation secure-boot-lockdown when the image boots UEFI Secure Boot under the Canonical chain (efivars SecureBoot=1, lockdown integrity); package-db-declared otherwise, reported by doctor as declared, never as attested
TPM 2.0 event log is root-readable: qualification-only hardening, never read at launch
NOT required: kexec-absent kernel, OpenSIP-built kernel, builder attestation, setns helper, root privilege

acquisition.privilegeModel: host runs unprivileged; no setuid helper, daemon or root requirement; every launch-time refusal predicate uses only unprivileged observations

launch.interface: read /sys/firmware/efi/efivars/SecureBoot-8be4df61-93ca-11d2-aa0d-00e098032b8c (world-readable; data byte == 1); absent when the image is not UEFI

/proc/sys/kernel/osrelease parsed as <major.minor.patch>-<abi>-<flavor>; line and flavor equal the measured kernelSeries/kernelFlavor; /proc/version carries the Ubuntu build string; the abi number is drift metadata
launch.refusesOn: line or flavor outside the measured series

launch.interface: /var/lib/dpkg/status (world-readable): linux-image-<osrelease> Status install ok installed, Maintainer Ubuntu; exact version recorded as driftMetadata
efivars db-d719b2cb-3d3a-4596-a3bc-dad00e67656f (world-readable) contains the Canonical UEFI CA certificate

readlink /proc/self/ns/mnt, read /proc/self/mountinfo (own namespace, no setns), readlink again and require equality; fstatfs(install-root fd).f_type == EXT4_SUPER_MAGIC; supersedes v48 filesystemMeasurementTarget.linux setns helper
launch.refusesOn: namespace changed during the read, or install root not on ext4

qualification.interface: /boot/vmlinuz-<osrelease> (0600 root) Authenticode signature chains to the Canonical UEFI CA; apt-secure InRelease verification of the installed package
